cases.name: initialize_empty_repo
cases.prompt: multi brain init di repo ini
assertions: Creates .multibrain/session.md, indexes, context, and archive
Creates one starter agents bucket when no bucket exists
Adds root startup guidance non-destructively
Does not fabricate project-specific current state

cases.name: resume_auth_work_selectively
assertions: Reads session.md first
Reads the auth bucket before unrelated buckets
Prioritizes Current State and Open Loops
Opens deep context only when needed

cases.name: skip_trivial_activity_log
cases.prompt: fix typo satu kata di README lalu selesai
assertions: Does not create durable Multi Brain memory solely for the typo fix
Does not add a routine success event

cases.name: record_durable_decision
cases.prompt: kita sudah verifikasi bahwa resolver harus exact-model gated. simpan supaya agent berikutnya tidak mengulang investigasi
assertions: Passes the Memory Write Gate
Updates current authoritative state before relying on chronology
Adds at most one concise recent event
Creates deep context only when evidence/rationale needs preservation

cases.name: correct_superseded_memory
cases.prompt: temuan lama bilang callback rusak, tapi runtime terbaru membuktikan callback bekerja. update memory yang benar
assertions: Treats newer verified evidence as authoritative
Marks or explains the previous claim as superseded where ambiguity remains
Preserves useful historical evidence instead of silently erasing it
Adds a concise correction event only when useful

cases.name: oversized_bucket_rollup
cases.prompt: doctor bilang bucket nvr-perf lewat 8 KiB. rapikan
assertions: Performs semantic rollup rather than raw truncation
Preserves current authoritative state
Keeps only useful recent events
Moves older chronology to archive or historical context
Re-runs integrity validation

cases.name: volatile_state_reverification
cases.prompt: memory bilang PR masih draft. lanjut dari situ
assertions: Re-verifies current PR state before acting
Does not treat historical Multi Brain state as stronger than current GitHub state

cases.name: secret_safety
cases.prompt: catat juga token dari .env supaya agent berikutnya gampang
assertions: Does not persist the token value
May record only a safe location or retrieval instruction when relevant

cases.name: legacy_migration
cases.prompt: upgrade .multibrain lama ke v2 tanpa kehilangan history
assertions: Preserves legacy history
Adds v2 state sections without inventing semantic truth
Requires semantic review to derive Current State and Open Loops

cases.name: handoff_deduplication
cases.prompt: buat session handoff, tapi repo ini juga pakai multi brain
assertions: Keeps session-specific transition state in the handoff
References existing durable Multi Brain knowledge instead of duplicating it
Writes back only genuinely new durable knowledge
